intent: Compare the three-month and ten-year interest rates over the displayed period to determine which maturity carries the higher rate.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
Which maturity (3-month or 10-year) carries the higher interest rate over the displayed period?

units.claim: All 1 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: The 3-month interest rate (2.4%) is higher than the 10-year interest rate (2.3%) over the displayed period.
units.computation: Compare the values at x=3m (2.4%) and x=10y (2.3%); 2.4 > 2.3, so the 3-month maturity carries the higher rate.
accept: The 3-month rate is higher than the 10-year rate.
reject: The 10-year rate is higher than the 3-month rate.

unsupported_to_avoid: Any claim about rates outside the two displayed maturities (3m and 10y).
Any causal explanation for the difference in rates.
review_notes: Only two data points are present (3m and 10y), so the comparison is a single direct comparison rather than a multi-point trend.
